# nsresolver_records (Data Source)

Lists the records in an NSResolver zone, optionally only those of one type and/or name. Useful for finding record ids to import.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every A record named "mail" in example.com.
data "nsresolver_records" "mail" {
  zone = "example.com"
  type = "A"
  name = "mail"
}

output "mail_addresses" {
  value = data.nsresolver_records.mail.records[*].answer
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) The zone, e.g. `example.com`.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only records with this name, e.g. `www` or `@`.
- `type` (String) Only records of this type, e.g. `A`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The zone name.
- `records` (Attributes List) The matching records, in the API's order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `answer` (String) The value.
- `flags` (Number) CAA flags.
- `fqdn` (String) Full name.
- `id` (String) Record id (for `terraform import nsresolver_record.x <zone>/<id>`).
- `name` (String) Name relative to the zone; `@` for the zone itself.
- `port` (Number) SRV port.
- `priority` (Number) MX/SRV priority.
- `tag` (String) CAA tag.
- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds.
- `type` (String) Record type.
- `weight` (Number) SRV weight.
